title: CLUE：无监督事件类型归纳与标注的对比学习框架
summary: 提出CLUE框架，通过联合嵌入表示事件的动词中心视角与语义视角，利用对比损失引导聚类实现事件类型归纳，并进行事件命名与优化，减少人工事件本体构建的成本与偏差。
summary_en: The CLUE framework addresses unsupervised event type induction, naming, and annotation. It introduces a joint embedding representation capturing both verb-centric and semantic views of events, uses contrastive loss-guided clustering for type induction, and performs event naming and refinement, reducing manual ontology creation costs and human bias.
